title: Marathon Update 1.1.5
author: Marathon_Team
contents: [h2]General[/h2][list][*][p]Added a new experimental PVE mode, [b]Vault Breaker[/b].[/p][list][*][p]Explore Cryo Archive as a crew, duo, or a solo player, taking on a progressively challenging series of vaults.[/p][/*][*][p]Grow stronger across multiple matches with progression that’s unique to Vault Breaker, and push towards the final vault and the mysterious entity within.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][i]Added support to Player Voice Reporting and Voice Moderation.[/i][/p][list][*][p]More information available at [url="https://bung.ie/voicemoderation"]bung.ie/voicemoderation[/url].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Item Economy[/h2][h3]Armory[/h3][list][*][p]Ganglion barters now have a stock limit of 3, with the exception of Hyphatic Gel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Ganglion barters could reroll during unintended scenarios.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some barter costs to include Rubber Salvage.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Cradle[/h3][list][*][p]The 25% reduction in Cradle progress has now been reverted.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Feature[/b]: Cradle Evolution[/p][list][*][p]Players whose Cradle has reached level 70 will see a new the option to "Evolve Cradle" below the Cradle XP bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Activating a Cradle Evolution will:[/p][list][*][p]Increases the Cradle energy limit by 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Reset the Cradle to level 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Reset all invested energy in each track of the Cradle.[/p][/*][*][p]Grants the Cradle 1 energy per Cradle Evolution stage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Cradle can be evolved a total of 7 times.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Pursuit Upgrades[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the MIDA capstone V upgrade's requirements were incorrectly displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where stacked upgrade nodes could become locked if the 6th capstone has not been unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where stacked upgrade nodes could incorrectly display that an upgrade is available to purchase.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Items & Inventory[/h3][list][*][p]Added a toggle to enable or disable a free sponsored kit upon death.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the sell option could be displayed twice in the item tooltip.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some Salvage items were not displaying their usages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sponsored kits would incorrectly display depleted self-revives.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where scrap could not be converted into credits even if there was inventory space to do so.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Ranked[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Rank points could incorrectly display as "0" in the Run Report.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Ranked sponsored kits would not immediately refresh on rank changes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Map Loot[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a UESC Cert in Algae Ponds was unable to be interacted with.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a container in Night Marsh Complex was unable to be interacted with.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a container in Night Marsh AI Uplink was clipping into the environment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a player could get stuck on a container in Cryo Vault 02.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a user could get stuck in a kick to login loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated multi-select item tile visuals to be more visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where selling all items in the overflow could be accidentally triggered.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Combat[/h2][h3]Equipment[/h3][p][b]Loadout-Limited Infil Limit[/b][/p][list][*][p]Starting mid-season, some equipment items are marked Loadout-Limited. Only 2 Loadout-Limited items are allowed in your loadout during infil. Having too many in your loadout will cause a Crew Error when preparing for a run. Extra items beyond the limit can still be collected in-game and exfiltrated; only infil is restricted.[/p][/*][*][p]Loadout-Limited items: Bubble Shield, Chem Grenade, EMP Grenade, Flechette Grenade, Frag Grenade, Heat Grenade[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Developer's Note: This new infil restriction has two purposes: reduce the efficacy of AOE grenade spam and reduce the prevalence of Bubble Shields. We think grenades are in a good place damage-wise, but feedback is clear that spam is still an issue on Cryo and that Bubble Shields are flattening high level combat.[/i][/p][p][b]Bubble Shield[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed the player slow down on entering a Bubble Shield volume[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced health in PVP from 560 to 400[/p][/*][*][p]Increased health against UESC from 1680 to 2500[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused explosions from grenades to not do any damage to Bubble Shields.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage explosions from grenades do to Bubble Shields by 2x.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Energy Amp[/b][/p][list][*][p]Passive prime ability regen reduced by 40%[/p][/*][*][p]Passive tactical/trait ability reduced by 40%[/p][/*][*][p]Increased buff time granted by Energy Amp from 2 minutes to 3 minutes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Effects[/h3][p][b]Invisibility[/b][/p][list][*][p]Invisibility will flicker off after sprinting for more than 2 seconds.[/p][list][*][p]Note: This change affects invisibility from any source.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]AI combatants can now hear the footsteps of Invisible players at very close range, and will now enter their search behavior when they do.[/p][/*][/list][p][b][i]Dev Note:[/i][/b][i] Invisibility is currently too powerful as a tool for completely sidestepping PvE encounters. We're taking a sizeable swing here to make it so players will need to be more intentional with their movement after activation. You'll still be able to navigate past enemies but choosing when to sprint and when to move more slowly will be more important. Alongside this change, we're increasing the uptime of Smoke Dive to help ensure that Assassin still has strong disengage tools at their disposal, and we'll continue to evaluate how Invisibility is playing moving forward.[/i][/p][h3]Runner Shells[/h3][p][b]Assassin[/b][/p][list][*][p]Smoke Dive[/p][list][*][p]Reduced base cooldown time from 60s to 45s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Recon[/b][/p][list][*][p]Echo Pulse[/p][list][*][p]Reduced Echo Pulse base wave count from 7 to 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased time between waves from 2.5s to 3s.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Echo Pulse base ping waypoint lifetime from 10s to 8s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: Echo Pulse is a primary contributor to undesired standoff behavior in our higher tier activities, so we're making some changes to reduce how quickly it snapshots enemy location information and the number of snapshots it provides. This should give players more time to reposition or push between pulses in combination with the changes to Energy Amp detailed above reducing its effective uptime for highly invested players. We'll be keeping an eye on this to see how it performs alongside the rest of the changes for future updates.[/i][/p][p][b]Thief[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pickpocket Drone[/p][list][*][p]While in flashlight-enabled Zones, Pickpocket Drone now has intrinsic Darksight to help pilots navigate through dark interior spaces more easily.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Sentinel[/b][/p][list][*][p]Defender System[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Defender System was able to catch grenades while fading out at the end of its lifetime.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced base cooldown time from 180 seconds to 150 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Snare Mine[/p][list][*][p]Increased maximum detonation damage per submunition from 5 to 7 against enemy Runners.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased maximum detonation damage per submunition from 30 to 35 against enemy non-Runners.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Prey Tracker[/p][list][*][p]Prey Tracker is no longer scrambled by Signal Jammer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: With the infil limit for grenades detailed above coming in, we wanted to give Sentinel's kit a bit more general usability to compensate. Snare Mine will be a more reliable damage tool, and Prey Tracker no longer has an easily accessible counter without downside. As with any new shell, dialing in potency will be a process that happens over time - we'll be monitoring Sentinel's performance for the rest of the season to see how things shake out.[/i][/p][p][b]Destroyer[/b][/p][list][*][p]Search and Destroy[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where sustained damage from the Biotoxic Disinjector weapon was not counting towards building rocket charges.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Rook[/b][/p][list][*][p]Recuperation[/p][list][*][p]Increased heal rate from 2hp/s to 3hp/s.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased healing duration from 20s to 30s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: With Season 2, Rook's playstyle shifted more firmly back into scavenger territory without an arsenal of claymores and shotguns, but its ability to recover from a bad situation without reliance on healing consumables with Recuperation wasn't hitting the bar. Overall healing has been more than doubled, making Rook much less reliant on finding Patch Kits in-run. The potency of Rook's arsenal is something we're looking at season-over-season to find the right potency.[/i][/p][h3]Implants[/h3][list][*][p]Updated implant iconography to better reflect each implant’s unique effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Triage Cloak[/p][list][*][p]Now also activates when using a Mercy Kit.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Backpacks[/h3][list][*][p]Sneak Pack[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Sneak Pack's Signal Jammer effect did not prevent claymore activations.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where removing a player's backpack from a death bag could result in loot being deleted when the player was revived.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapons[/h3][p][b]D54 Battle Pistol[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced precision bonus multiplier from 1.5x to 1.38x[/p][list][*][p][i]Developer's Note: This seems like a small change but this change means the D54 Battle Pistol requires 3 precision bursts to down a Grey Shield Runner, up from 2 Bursts, and 4 bursts to down a Purple Shield Runner, up from 3 bursts.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reduced damage fall range minimum and maximum across all stat tiers by 10%.[/p][list][*][p]Maximum 100 Range stat damage falloff minimum goes from 38 meters to 34 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum 100 Range stat damage falloff maximum goes from 72 meters to 64 meters.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]V22 Volt Thrower[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed the 0.5s target acquisition time to better enable ambush style gameplay[/p][list][*][p]The visual target indicator always showed immediately but projectiles wouldn't actually track until after being on target for 0.5 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increased projectile velocity speed from 56 m/s to 80 m/s.[/p][/*][*][p]Completely retuned rate of fire and firing spin down.[/p][list][*][p]Increased max rpm from 507.3 to 540[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased min rpm from 309.3 to 140[/p][/*][*][p]Spin down based on heat now spins down more linearly instead of the previous behavior[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Twin Tap HBR[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased base damage from 22 to 24.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased precision bonus multiplier from 1.3 to 1.4.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the speed between rounds in a burst by 50%.[/p][list][*][p]Retuned recoil direction to compensate.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased intensity of sim input and camera shake to compensate.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased stability at the lower investment tiers by ~20% to compensate.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where ADS Accuracy starting cone size did not improve with ADS Accuracy stat increases.[/p][/*][*][p]Q-Tap Regen Prestige Mod:[/p][list][*][p]Increased the base damage from 15 to 19.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the base rate of fire to match normal rate instead of decreasing it.[/p][list][*][p][i]Developer's Note: We heard the feedback on the Prestige Mod hurting the PVP performance of this mod too much compared to the base gun. In our testing, optimal TTKs are now comparable with that of the base weapon.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Removed the low health requirement on the Prestige Mod healing perk:[/p][list][*][p]Hitting 4 precision hits in rapid succession starts health regeneration.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the heal rate from 1.5x the speed of a Patch Kit to 0.8x the speed of a Patch Kit to compensate for the ease of use buff.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 3 second cooldown since this perk can now be activated theoretically back to back.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]KKV-9SD[/b][/p][list][*][p]Redistributed damage profile to lower reliance on headshots.[/p][list][*][p][i]Developer's Note: KKV always had a mathematically faster optimal TTK than most weapons but it was reliant on almost entirely headshots and missing a single one would result in a massive drop in TTK. This change makes the optimal TTK remain as fast as before but it makes body shot TTK faster and the punishment of missing a single headshot much less.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increased base damage to 9, up from 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced precision damage scale to 1.29x, from 1.45x.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]CE Tactical Sidearm[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved ADS Accuracy starting cone size on the base version by ~10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved ADS Accuracy final cone size on base version by ~13%.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bully SMG[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced Rodeo Mag size from 72 to 61.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced maximum magazine size from Drum Mag from 66 to 58.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced damage falloff at the high end and retuned damage falloff at all range stats to compensate. This results in Bully's maximum range before suffering falloff to be reduced from 40 meters to 32 meters and maximum damage falloff range to be reduced from 70 meters to 62 meters.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]WSTR Combat Shotgun[/b][/p][list][*][p]Damage increased from 85 to 100.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced precision bonus multiplier from 1.05x to 1.0x.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased spread by 20% across all stat tiers.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced aim assist falloff start at the top end by 30%.[/p][list][*][p]Retuned stat tiers to compensate.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reduced aim assist falloff end at the top end by 12%.[/p][list][*][p]Retuned stat tiers to compensate.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reduced magnetism falloff by ~10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced minimum damage percentage at max falloff from 20% to 10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Retuned damage falloff across all tiers:[/p][list][*][p]2HKO range with a grey WSTR against base shields: 3 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]2HKO range with a grey WSTR against purple shields: 2 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]2HKO range with a max invested WSTR against base shields: 7 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]2HKO range with a max invested WSTR against purple shields: 4 meters.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Misriah 2442[/b][/p][list][*][p]Damage reduced from 140 to 110.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced precision bonus multiplier from 1.2x to 1.0x.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced rpm from 72 to 58.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the range stat to not modify aim assist or magnetism falloff:[/p][list][*][p]This results in roughly a 30% buff to aim assist when at 100 range stat but roughly a 25% nerf to magnetism at 100 range stat.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Retuned damage falloff across all tiers:[/p][list][*][p]2HKO range with a grey Misriah against base shields: 10 meters (was 11 meters).[/p][/*][*][p]2HKO range with a grey Misriah against purple shields: 9 meters (was 10 meters).[/p][/*][*][p]2HKO range with a max investment Misriah against base shields: 14 meters (was 18 meters).[/p][/*][*][p]2HKO range with a max investment Misriah against purple shields: 12 meters (was 16 meters).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Full-Auto Selector Prestige Mod[/p][list][*][p]Reduced hipfire rpm from 72 to 58.[/p][/*][*][p]Both hipfire and ADS now fire full auto, as opposed to just hipfire.[/p][/*][*][p]In addition to previous benefits, hipfire mode massively increases movement speed with the Misriah equipped.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Volt Battery Weapons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the amount of trickle charge generated while moving with Volt Battery weapons equipped by 4x.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Chips[/h3][p][b]Exit Buddy[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed unintentional camera shake on perk activation.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where switching weapons while mantling could store weapon charge state in some circumstances.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Contracts[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Mida "Expose/Extinguish" contract where one crew could expose/extinguish all the stockpiles, blocking progression for other crews.[/p][/*][*][p]Traxus “Unsanctioned Hostilities \[5/5]” now supports recovering the targeted contract item from other players and will grant objective progress.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Zones[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed multiple issues involving containment, floating geometry, or loot that was inaccessible due to map geometry.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sources of faction reputation to Cryo Archive.[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional cover near infils in Dire Marsh where infil rushing was easily exploited.[/p][/*][*][p]Exfil icons in Cryo Archive no longer use the guarded exfil map icon, and fixed an issue where waypoints did not appear on exfils until pinged on the mini map.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the duration that icons remain on the HUD after using a Scanner in Cryo Archive.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where incorrect audio queues were playing on UESC Network Towers on Night Marsh.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could get squashed by a UESC dropship in Bioresearch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where DCON waypoints were leading to incorrect locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the horn on the hauler was missing an interact prompt.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Anomalous Substance waypoint was not updating correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Oni would announce that UESC Convoy was active, but the Convoy did not spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed //THEN requirement from Traxus "Return on Investment 5/5" to credit all contract holders when stockpile spawns to allow contract completion by last holder of salvage on exfil.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where "IN A SINGLE RUN" was present on crew objectives in the objective HUD widget.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Stability and Graphics[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that could cause a graphics crash when closing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a graphics crash that occurred when players were unable to enable FSR.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a graphics crash that occurred when the game experienced heavy loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved reticle visibility when playing in HDR mode.[/p][/*][*][p]The flashlight no longer appears blocky when close to a surface when anti-aliasing and variable-rate shading is active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing flashing graphic artifacts on UESC shields in Night Marsh.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Thief X-Ray performance when using an AMD GPU.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where signing into the game on a second device would cause both devices to wait for over a minute before timing out the first device.[/p][/*][/list]

title: Vault Breaker Overview | Marathon
author: Marathon_Team
contents: [p][/p][previewyoutube="ec5bLvYiWZo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Vault Breaker is Marathon's first experimental PvE mode, set in Cryo Archive. Play as a crew, duo, or solo—no enemy players. Power up across runs with roguelite progression to overcome UESC hordes, vault security measures.... and even the Compiler. Available July 21 - August 4.[/p]

title: Mid-Season 2 Update Preview
author: Marathon_Team
contents:
[p]The mid-season update is coming next week.[/p][p]It brings a lot with it including our first experimental PvE mode Vault Breaker and a fresh batch of balance and progression updates.[/p][p]Let’s get into it.[/p][p][/p][h1]Experimental PvE Mode: Vault Breaker[/h1][p][/p][p]Vault Breakers utilize hit-and-run tactics to master the secrets of the Marathon’s Cryo Archive. They travel light and target the Archive’s many vaults in search of valuable loot and deeper access throughout the deck.[/p][p]Vault Breakers’ strategic deployments challenge the UESC’s jurisdiction aboard the Marathon—applying constant pressure to defend the zone against Runner incursions. They strike during “quiet” moments—while rival crews are focused on Tau Ceti IV—to keep the UESC off guard and to maneuver with more focus, free of the chaos of a contested zone.[/p][p]When Update 1.1.5 arrives on July 21, the Vault Breaker mode will open its doors and send Runners into Cryo Archive for Marathon’s first experimental PvE mode. You can jump in straight away, whether you’re running Solo, as a Duo, or with a full Trio - and that’s true regardless of your Runner Level.[/p][p]Vault Breaker offers a roguelite PvE experience inside Cryo Archive, where you’ll take on progressively tougher Vaults across multiple runs. You’ll acquire Vault Data to upgrade your special Sponsored Kit (more details below), or spend that progress on gear in the new Vault Breaker Armory that features weapons, item, and more that you can bring back to your other adventures across Tau Ceti.[/p][p][/p][p]* Please note that all items and gear found in-run are restricted from exfil except event currency and rewards will only be available during the event period, so best to prioritize room for Vault Data and of course, items essential for you to make it to exfil.[/p][p][/p][p]Vault Breaker is our very first experimental PvE mode. We're excited for you all to jump in and check it out, and we can't wait to gather up all of your feedback and data as we continue to work towards our full PvE mode, arriving in Season 3.[/p][p]Vault Breaker begins with Update 1.1.5 on July 21st and runs through August 4th.
[/p][h2]Vault Breaker Armory[/h2][p]The update also brings changes to the Armory tab, including a new Vault Breaker Armory option under the Event section.[/p][p]Each run, you’ll earn Vault Data, a special event currency that can be spent in the Vault Breaker Armory to upgrade the special Sponsored Kit for stronger PvE runs, or to purchase items and gear that can be used outside the event.[/p][p]There are two tiers of Vault Data to earn:[/p][list][*][p]Tier 1 Vault Data can be found in Vaults and then needs to be exfilled.[/p][list][*][p]Tier One Vault Data is also awarded for killing a UESC Commander, and that reward is granted post-run whether you successfully exfil or not.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tier 2 Vault Data can only be earned from consecutive Vaults solved in the same run and then successfully exfilled. You’ll need to manage your time and routes wisely. This will be especially tough for solo Runners.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276530/8b89364c5952f0cc7bd35567cdf6eb6464cbcba4.png"][/img][/p][h2]Armory Offers[/h2][p]The Armory features a variety of gear and items, including a daily rotating Deluxe weapon, Cryo Key Templates, Prestige Weapons, and more. It’s worth noting that some pinnacle rewards stock will remain fixed in number throughout the full event.[/p][p]Here’s a quick look at how the weekly rotation breaks down:[/p][list][*][p]Weekly Offers[/p][list][*][p]Tier 1 Vault Data items will have limited weekly stock, depending on the item, with either 3x or 5x available per week.[/p][/*][*][p]Tier 2 Vault Data items will include higher-tier rewards with 1x limited stock per week, or players can convert that currency to Tier One at 5x per week.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Limited Offers[/p][list][*][p]Prestige gear will be available and you can grab one of each during the event. Grab them while you can.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]*Please note purchases made from the Weekly and Limited Offers apply only to standard Marathon activities. Only Kit Upgrades will alter your loadout in Vault Breaker.[/p][p][/p][h2]Unique Sponsored Kit & Upgrades[/h2][p]To access Vault Breaker, you’ll need to equip the free special Sponsored Kit found in the Vault Breaker Armory tab under the Events section.[/p][p]This Sponsored Kit won’t be in its final form when you first grab it. At the start, the kit is at its weakest, offering only one standard weapon along with a small amount of equipment and consumables.[/p][p]As you earn Vault Data, different upgrade paths will begin to open.[/p][p]You might want to focus on weapon quality. Others may want more survivability, or they may want to get started with a wider mix of implants and cores. The path is entirely up to you.[/p][p]And of course, Cradle and Faction upgrades will also be enabled for the event.[/p][p][/p][h2]Crews and Queues[/h2][p]Looking to test yourself against the dangers of Cryo? We’ve got a Solo queue waiting for you. It’s you against the UESC, and you’re unfortunately on their turf.[/p][p]Want to bring some backup or learn Cryo alongside your friends? As always, worry not, we’ll have Duos and Trios – both for matchmade and pre-made Crews.[/p][p]And to commemorate your time aboard the UESC Marathon as you try to break some vaults, there’s unique Codex challenges that will reward you with some cosmetics to show off to your fellow-Runners.[/p][p][/p][h2]Codex Challenges and Rewards[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276530/4c6d4de3bce89590826eff9c213a76fc0deddec9.png"][/img][/p][p]There will be 4 unique Vault Breaker Codex challenges available that award cosmetics:[/p][list][*][p]Profile Emblem - Opposition marker[/p][/*][*][p]Profile Background – UESC Command[/p][/*][*][p]Circuit Breaker Weapon Style – UESC Bulwark[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Charm – USEC Control[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h1]Sandbox and Update Highlights:[/h1][p] [/p][p] [b]WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT[/b][/p][p]Howdy, Weapons & Equipment team here, and we're here to highlight a couple of changes coming in the Mid-Season Update. This will not be every change in the update but we wanted to put a few of these in front of you early, perhaps to prepare your vaults just in case.[/p][p]AN AGENT OF CHAOS RETURNS[/p][p]Back from the timeout corner, the WSTR is indeed getting buffed - though not quite back to its former glory. Let's dive right in:[/p][list][*][p]WSTR Combat Shotgun[/p][list][*][p]Damage increased from 85 to 100[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced precision bonus multiplier from 1.05x to 1.0x[/p][/*][*][p]Increased spread by 20% across all stat tiers[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced aim assist falloff start at the top end by 30%[/p][list][*][p]Retuned stat tiers to compensate[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reduced aim assist falloff end at the top end by 12%[/p][list][*][p]Retuned stat tiers to compensate[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reduced magnetism falloff by ~10%[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced minimum damage percentage at max falloff from 20% to 10%[/p][/*][*][p]Retuned damage falloff across all tiers:[/p][list][*][p]2HKO range with a grey WSTR against base shields: 3 meters[/p][/*][*][p]2HKO range with a grey WSTR against purple shields: 2 meters[/p][/*][*][p]2HKO range with a max invested WSTR against base shields: 7 meters[/p][/*][*][p]2HKO range with a max invested WSTR against purple shields: 4 meters[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]First off we are removing all precision damage bonus multipliers from ballistic shotguns - the Misriah will also inherit this change, leaving Circuit Breaker as the only shotgun to receive a precision damage bonus. We feel that this better matches their identity as burst damage options that are about putting as many pellets on target as possible instead of the head.[/p][p]While the WSTR is regaining its 2-shot down potential, it's now extremely range limited. Through buildcrafting, it is possible to extend this range just a bit. We are excited to see how this plays out as it is somewhat of a middle ground between the menace that the gun was at launch and where it is today. The WSTR has a deserved reputation for terror, so we will be watching this closely.

And of course, the Misriah will receive some much-needed adjustment on the 21st as well. Look forward to the full patch notes for details![/p][p][/p][p][b]ABOUT THE SPICY HANDGUN[/b][/p][p]It's safe to say the D54 Battle Pistol made a wild impression in its Tau Ceti IV debut. We're happy that people are enjoying the gun's feel and identity, but we are also aware that maybe it's a tad out of band. Here's the Mid-Season Update balance changes for the Battle Pistol:[/p][list][*][p] D54 Battle Pistol[/p][list][*][p]Reduced precision bonus multiplier from 1.5x to 1.38x[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced damage falloff range minimum and maximum across all stat tiers by 10%[/p][list][*][p]Maximum 100 Range stat damage falloff minimum goes from 38 meters to 34 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum 100 Range stat damage falloff maximum goes from 72 meters to 64 meters.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]This seems like a small series of changes but this change means the D54 Battle Pistol requires 3 precision bursts to down a Grey Shield Runner, up from 2 Bursts, and 4 bursts to down a Purple Shield Runner, up from 3 bursts. In our playtesting, we believe that time for the extra burst has had a tangible effect on bringing the Battle Pistol in line with other weapons.
[/p][p][b]ONE GRENADE FOR EACH HAND[/b][/p][p]Starting with the Mid-Season Update we are making a dramatic change to how some throwables work prior to infilling to a run. On July 21st, Runners trying to load into a map will find themselves with an error preventing them to launch if they are holding more than the restricted limit of certain equipment in their backpack.[/p][p]To start, we are limiting Runners to only bring any combination of 2 Bubble Shields, Chem Grenades, EMP Grenades, Flechette Grenades, Frag Grenades, and Heat Grenades. This means you can only bring in 2 Frag Grenades at the start of a run, or maybe 1 Frag Grenade and 1 Bubble Shield. Either way, any items on this list will be limited to a combination of 2. While in a run, any additional grenades on this list that are scavenged are fair game.[/p][p] This new infil restriction has two purposes: reduce the efficacy of AOE grenade spam and reduce the prevalence of Bubble Shields. We think grenades are in a good place damage-wise, but feedback is clear that spam is still an issue on Cryo and that Bubble Shields are flattening high level combat.[/p][p]We may change the items on this list or the infil limit number in the future so please give us feedback on how this new system is working out![/p][p][/p][p][b]IMPLANT ICONOGRAPHY UPDATE[/b][/p][p]Thanks to your feedback we've continued iterating on the iconography on your Implants. They should be easier to understand at-a-glance, but as always - let us know how you like them! Check them out when the full update hits next week.[/p][p]In the meantime, here's a quick preview:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276530/cd3062d3f80d02a61cbd9d56101d864f556750a1.png"][/img][/p][p][b]CRADLE EVOLUTION SYSTEM[/b] [/p][p]Ever since the Cradle arrived you've all been diving in head-first, sacrificing a tremendous number of your exfilled wares to the WEAVEworms. To that end, we've gone ahead and reverted the 25% reduction Cradle progress so you can continue to bolster your buildcrafting. 
 
Mid-season also brings the first iteration of the Cradle Evolution system. Upon maxing out your Cradle, you’ll now be able to reset back to zero to earn one additional maximum Energy point and unlock unique cosmetics, including multiple Runner shell styles. [/p][p][/p][h2]Stay cool out there[/h2][p]We can't wait for you to hop on in and see what we've cooked up.[/p][p]Vault Breaker, which runs from July 21st through August 4th, is our first foray into an experimental PvE mode, and our ears will be to the ground listening for your feedback that will help us continue to iterate as we continue to evolve PVE into Season 3. Make sure to drop by our [url="http://discord.gg/marathonthegame"][u]Discord[/u][/url], send an @ to our [url="https://x.com/MarathonDevTeam"][u]Twitter[/u][/url] or [url="https://bsky.app/profile/marathonteam.bungie.net"][u]Bluesky[/u][/url], and of course be sure and drop by the [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/Marathon/"][u]Reddit[/u][/url].[/p][p]
[/p]

title: Marathon Dev Team Update: Key Dates
author: Marathon_Team
contents: [p]As we move deeper into the new season, we want to share some important dates coming up for Marathon. [/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Mid-Season Begins July 21[/b] [/h2][p]First up, mid-season will start on July 21 and will include...  [/p][p] [/p][h3]Introducing Vault Breaker [/h3][p]Marathon's experimental PVE mode: Vault Breaker. Explore Cryo Archive as a crew, duo, or solo player, taking on a progressively challenging series of vaults. Grow stronger across multiple matches with progression that’s unique to Vault Breaker, and push towards the final vault and the mysterious entity within. [/p][p] [/p][p]Vault Breaker requires a special Sponsored Kit to queue up, and any gear or items you find stay behind when you exfil. The exception to this is Vault Data. This new currency is found within vaults, and when extracted, can be exchanged for upgrades to your Vault Breaker Sponsored Kits as well as gear that can be used in other modes. This let’s you experience Cryo Archive without flooding the economy with low-risk, high-power Cryo loot. [/p][p] [/p][h3]Cradle Evolution System [/h3][p]️Mid-season also brings the first iteration of the Cradle Evolution system. Upon maxing out your Cradle, you’ll now be able to reset back to zero to earn one additional maximum Energy point and unlock unique cosmetics, including multiple Runner shell styles. These cosmetics will be available later in the season, but if you unlock them ahead of time, you’ll automatically receive them once they’re available. With this change, Cradle progression speeds will also be increased. [/p][p] [/p][h3]More to Come! [/h3][p]Various other quality-of-life, tuning, and other changes, including the addition of player profile stats. [/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Season 3 Begins September 22[/b] [/h2][p]Looking further ahead, Season 3 will begin on September 22 and brings big changes to the early game experience, including a revamp of Perimeter to add major new areas, encounters, and gameplay. Season 3 also introduces a new Runner shell, new weapons and equipment, and lots of other content and surprises. [/p][p] [/p][p]We’ll share more details about mid-season, including a full rundown on Vault Breakers, and our Season 3 plans as we get closer to their live dates. [/p]

title: Marathon Dev Team Update: A Note on the Season 2 Economy
author: Marathon_Team
contents: [p]There’s been a lot of conversations about the loot economy and drop changes in Season 2, and we want to share more about how we’re thinking about the loot economy overall.[/p][p][/p][p]Out the gate in Season 2, progression and access to power moved much faster than the previous season. For reference, the average wealth in week two of Season 2 is similar to what we saw in weeks 11 and 12 of Season 1. And while we did want to increase progression speeds, we didn’t land at a place that’s healthy for the game.[/p][p][/p][p]There are a few things we’re tracking that are contributing to this accelerated pace:[/p][list][*][p]There’s an issue causing higher rarity loot to be more prevalent throughout the game than we see internally. This isn’t something we’ve seen in our internal playtests, and we’re still unravelling the source.[/p][/*][*][p]There were various bugs and other issues we’ve fixed in recent updates, such as guaranteed gold drops in places that shouldn’t have them.[/p][/*][*][p]While not the main cause, the influx of Sponsored Kits at the start of the season bolstered progression speeds.[/p][/*][*][p]While also not the main cause, the Sponsored Survival grind combined with an issue with the Complex Control chest also contributed to bloated Vaults.[/p][/*][*][p]The combination of these things has led to increased progression across the board, including with the Cradle.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]While we continue investigating the source of the loot drop issues, we've made some tweaks targeting progression, some of which we hope to reverse later in the season when we have other solutions in place. This includes the boosted containers being turned off and nerfs to Cradle XP rates.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all of your feedback so far, and we’ll keep you posted on any developments or future changes to come.[/p]
